items.title: Clorox (CLX) Stock Rebounds As Q4 Earnings Face Margin Strain
items.summary: Clorox stock jumped 4.3% in regular trading to US$93.77, as investors reacted to fresh Q4 2026 numbers and the latest read on profit pressure. The move comes after a choppy 90 days for the shares, which were down over that stretch before today’s bounce. The headline story is margin strain, not sales excitement.
